name: SKULL-9
manufacturer: Special alloy developed by the government (in-game lore)
tagline: A giant government-alloy battle axe with murderous power against zombies.
summary: SKULL-9 (the Skull Axe) is a large two-handed battle axe forged from a special alloy developed by the government, with destructive power aimed squarely at zombies. It has a longer reach than normal melee weapons, can hit multiple targets in one swing and does not slow the player down, but each slash has a delay and a low swing rate. It was sold only for limited periods and later offered through Bingo events and booster packs.
description: The wiki describes SKULL-9 as a large battle axe made from a type of special alloy material developed by the government, with murderous destruction power especially towards zombies; it also has the Part System installed. Its primary attack is a vertical slash and its secondary a horizontal slash with a wider damage area but shorter range - the first melee weapon in CSO whose primary and secondary attacks deal equal damage. In Zombie modes a head hit deals 2,900 and body/chest/gut/leg hits 725 (up to 8,700 with a max-damage head hit), and it kills unarmored humans in one swing in normal matches (Kevlar reduces a 100 HP hit to 15). In Zombie Scenario it excels at breaking obstacles, mini-bosses and grouped zombies; in Human Scenario it kills Troopers and Lancers in one slash and Titans in two head slashes. Earlier versions dealt lower damage and weighed as much as an AWP.
